children: Stanley Black & Decker announced an agreement to sell Excel Industries, owner of the Hustler brand, to Bad Boy Mowers, with Excel expected to generate about $300 million in FY2026 revenue.
Entered definitive Equity and Asset Purchase Agreement to sell Excel Industries and certain Hustler-related assets to Bad Boy Mowers.
Excel is expected to generate approximately $300 million of revenue in FY2026, per the company disclosure.
Transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
Company does not expect the transaction to be dilutive to adjusted EPS; Excel remains in continuing operations until close.
